objective: Remove app-side ad startup latency and permanent empty ad reservations while preserving consent, policy, route safety and bounded request cadence.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: DEV main baseline 6da48e5da0335c26996469faf0cf3328e8dceaf8. Read-only production telemetry for Android runtime 1.3.2/build 28 on 2026-11-03 shows live ad requests but high no-fill on first-view placements (profile 56 requests/42 no-fill, Home 19/10, public Wall entry 57/24). Production OTA remains separate; this work does not publish an OTA.
chosenApproach: Start AdMob immediately from previously valid UMP consent while refreshing consent asynchronously; keep first-run consent fail-closed; collapse terminal no-fill slots; use tiny measurable probes and one cooldown-bound retry.
selectionRationale: Observed blank spaces are created by app-owned reserved shells and timeout frames, while startup waits on nonessential UMP refresh. Fix deterministic client behavior without changing native SDK, live unit IDs, content rating, or AdMob request volume.
alternativeApproaches: Increase ad density or remove request cooldowns: rejected because it does not solve blank rendering and risks policy/request inflation.
Change PG content rating or replace ad units: rejected because inventory suitability and live unit IDs need separate AdMob account evidence.
Keep 68-392 dp placeholders while waiting: rejected because a failed or delayed ad leaves empty content space.
preserveBehaviors: UMP consent remains mandatory before first-ever ad requests.
Previously valid consent may serve ads while UMP refreshes, with updated consent state applied when refresh completes.
PG maximum ad content rating is unchanged.
Existing live AdMob app IDs and unit IDs are unchanged.
Route safety, remote kill switches, foreground checks, interaction locks and shared request reservations remain.
No-fill retries remain bounded by the existing two-minute shared cooldown.
Ads never block navigation, posting, chat, reading, submissions or offline access.
Native SDK/package/runtime and production OTA are unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: No artificial 600 ms AdMob bootstrap delay.
Returning users with canRequestAds=true initialize the SDK without waiting for UMP refresh; first-run consent remains fail-closed.
Concurrent startup calls share one bootstrap and one consent refresh.
First-view ad wrappers do not retain permanent empty min-height shells.
Native feed probes and pending banner frames are 8 dp; full-size frames appear only after an ad loads.
No-fill and terminal errors collapse the slot and allow only a cooldown-bound recovery.
Focused ad regression tests, TypeScript QA and engineering accountability gates pass.
No production OTA until the exact RC and runtime 1.3.2 release gates are independently verified.
